name: Water, waste and construction

bnote.360003: VA Tech Wabag builds and runs water-treatment plants in India and abroad. Veolia is the world's largest water and waste company.
bnote.360005: India's piped-water utilities are run by city bodies and are not listed. These are large listed water utilities abroad.
bnote.370004: Indian sewage-treatment builders and operators, plus Pennon (UK).
bnote.381101: Antony Waste is India's only listed municipal waste collector. The rest are the largest US waste companies.
bnote.410001: India's five largest listed property developers.
bnote.410002: L&T is India's largest contractor. The rest build buildings and factories on contract.
bnote.421001: Listed Indian road builders and toll operators.
bnote.421004: India's two listed railway construction PSUs.
bnote.422003: India's listed power-transmission EPC companies, plus Quanta Services (US).
bnote.429001: Engineers India designs refineries and process plants. Fluor is a large US engineering contractor.
bnote.432107: No listed Indian rooftop-solar installer with clean data. Sunrun is the largest in the US.

flags.dlf: Net profit is far above EBITDA, which points to large other income or one-off gains; net margin is not an operating figure.
flags.godrejprop: Property developers book revenue when projects are handed over, so yearly margins swing a lot.
flags.run: Sunrun's profit depends on accounting for tax-equity partners; operating cash flow is the better guide.
flags.flr: Fluor reported a loss after write-downs on its stake in NuScale and on projects.

notes: Section E covers water, waste and construction
Your file places construction (NIC 41–43) in this section, so it is mapped here. India has many listed builders and road companies; water utilities and waste firms are mostly abroad.
